# CPython documentation samples

These are verbatim docstring excerpts from CPython 3.13.5's
`Lib/urllib/request.py` (module) and `Lib/smtplib.py` (`SMTP.sendmail`).
Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.13.5/Lib
License: Python Software Foundation License Version 2.

They contain published example values, not live credentials or customer data.
Tests require exact docstring content and the expected module/owner before
treating them as documentation. Changed values and executable assignments
must remain findings.
